result:
Both findings from the stop hook are fixed, and the typecheck and all nine tests still pass.

- **`PostController.update`** now calls `await this.authorize('update', [Post, post])` before the write, the same check `destroy` already makes. Only the post's author can update it.
- **`PostController.store`** no longer uses `forceCreate`. It calls `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })`. `authorId` stays out of `fillable` and out of the body schema, so request data can't reach it.

`guren audit` no longer reports either finding. Two dependency advisories remain: a `source-map-js` high-severity advisory, which is an error and fails the audit, and a low-severity `katex` advisory. Both are pre-existing and come from packages this change doesn't touch, so they need dependency upgrades rather than code changes. I haven't made those upgrades, so the audit still reports a failure until they're done. Say if you want me to upgrade them.
